clauses.clause_label: Restrictions on use of software and source code
clauses.scope_note: Applies to the software and its source code, in whole or in part. These lines state no affirmative grant; copying, modification, distribution, or use is prohibited unless the author gives express written permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the user has not obtained the author's express written permission.

coverage_notes: The supplied text provides no terms for sublicensing, combining, charging, network access, training, source provision, attribution, fees, or other activities beyond the stated prohibition. No permission is inferred for activities or artifacts not addressed.
